Name: Immersive Spouses - Victor (SVE)
Author: Yuanyuan950215
Description:
[s]This is a patch for Victor (SVE) provided by [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/40526170]aveii[/url][s] and [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/104833613]SuperMonkey1308[/url][s] for the Immersive Spouses mod.[/s]
[b][i]V1.1.0  [/i]I’ve already separated the whole module, so there's no need to download the original module anymore. & Support internationalization (i18n)

[/b]
I really love Victor, but I didn’t want him to be stuck at home as a househusband after marriage, so I took the liberty of creating a post-marriage schedule and some sweet conversations for him:

[b][b]＊[/b]Every Tue –[/b]
Restores his past routine of going to Shearwater Bridge
→ He will go to Shearwater Bridge to scout (but this won't affect the 14-heart event)

[b][b]＊[/b]Every Sat –[/b]
On the 6th of each season, he will go back to the library like he did before marriage
→ Adds some dialogue to let you know he wants to learn about some magical fields

On the 13th of each season, he will return to the Blue Moon Vineyard like he did before marriage
→ Adds some flirty dialogue that might even make him tease you about being jealous of Sophia

On the 27th of each season, he will visit the Adventurer's Guild
→ Adds some dialogue to show he cares about your adventuring career; he might feel a bit of jealousy towards Lance (?)

[b][b]＊[/b]Night Market -[/b]
In winter, on the 17th, he goes to the night market after finishing his chores and invites you to join him.

*You can check the detailed dialogue content in the json file

[b]//Installation Instructions//[/b]
[b]Now, Just download it directly, extract it, and put it in the Mod folder.[/b]

[s]You need to download the original mod and its related dependencies
For versions before 1.6: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5117]Immersive Spouses - Improved Spouse Schedules[/url]
For version 1.6:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22538] Immersive Spouses for 1.6[/url]
Directly add the files and folders from this patch to the original module's folder and overwrite the original files.[/s]

[b]//Disclaimer//[/b]
1. This is a file I edited for personal use and shared; if there's any infringement, please let me know, and I will delete it
2. As mentioned, please do not use it for profit
3. I'm a coding newbie, so there's a high chance I won't maintain this regularly; anyone willing to help maintain it is welcome
4. Translations into other languages are welcome; I used simplified Chinese directly due to the game version I’m using

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[s]這是由[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/40526170]aveii[/url] 和 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/104833613]SuperMonkey1308[/url] 提供的Immersive Spouses(沉浸式配偶)模組來增加的Victor(SVE)補丁
[/s][b][i]V1.1.0 [/i]我已經將整個模組獨立出來了，現在不需要下載原模組 & 支援國際化 (i18n)[/b]

因為我很愛維克多，但我不想讓他婚後都綁在家當主夫，所以擅自編寫了屬於他的婚後行程和一些甜甜的對話：

＊每周二－
還原他過去會跑去海鷗橋的行程
→他會去海鷗橋勘察（但這不會影響１４心的劇情感受）

＊每周六－
每季６日會還原他婚前會去圖書館的行程
→增加一些對話會讓你知道他想接觸一些魔法領域的知識

每季１３日會還原他婚前會去藍月葡萄園的行程
→增加一些會對你調情的對話，甚至會安撫你吃索菲亞的醋

每季２７日增加拜訪冒險者公會
→增加一些對話會讓你知道他很關心你的冒險事業，他可能會對蘭斯有一點危機感（？）

＊夜市－
冬季１７日他會在做完家務後前往夜市，並邀請你一起

※詳細對話內容可以開啟json檔案起來看


//安裝方法//
現在直接下載後解壓縮放在Mod資料夾即可

[s]需要下載原模組與其相關依賴模組
1.6以前版本: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5117]Immersive Spouses - Improved Spouse Schedules[/url]
1.6版本:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22538] Immersive Spouses for 1.6
[/url]將本補丁的文件和文件夾直接加入原模組﻿的資料夾並覆蓋原文件[/s]
